# Contributing

- ***Bug Reporting*** -> Report a bug which can be:
    - Bug
    - Feature Request
    - Translation Submission / Update
- ***QA & Tester*** -> Test pre-releases when:
    - I cannot test on my own reader/desktop.
    - I tested on desktop only but not in my e-readers.
- ***Translator*** -> Read the [translation guide](https://example.com/translations).

> For a small feature rework like:
>   + Moving settings of place
>   + Adding a small feature

1. First step
   - Nested unordered step
     1. Deep numbered step
        continued on another line
   - [x] Nested task
2. Second step

    A second paragraph in the same item.

    ```lua
    print('nested code')
    ```
